Mandatory for a spectrum stage; when fields_only, show Existing spectrum if source saved, or Not computed in this field-only action for manual fields. Do not promise new R/T/A from a field-only job.

cards.title: Study definition

fields.label: S4 study

fields.label: Single wavelength
fields.validation: Compile mode=Wavelength sweep and wl_start_nm=wl_stop_nm=this wavelength. Preserve positive cached wl_step_nm; exactly one sample. Existing backend has no Single wavelength mode string.

fields.label: Wavelength start
fields.validation: Positive finite. stop >= start. A draft with invalid cross-field order is retained but cannot run.
fields.error_message: Wavelength start must be positive and no greater than stop.

fields.label: Wavelength stop
fields.validation: Positive finite; >= start. Actual last sampled value may differ from requested stop.
fields.error_message: Wavelength stop must be no less than start.

fields.label: Wavelength step
fields.validation: Positive finite; floor((stop-start)/step + 1e-9)+1 <= 20,000,000.
fields.error_message: Increase wavelength step or split the study; maximum 20,000,000 samples.

fields.label: Fixed wavelength
fields.validation: Positive finite. One wavelength is used for all angle samples.

fields.label: Angle start
fields.validation: Finite strictly between ±90°. stop >= start.
fields.error_message: Angle start must be inside ±90° and no greater than stop.

fields.label: Angle stop
fields.validation: Finite strictly between ±90°; >= start.
fields.error_message: Angle stop must be inside ±90° and no less than start.

fields.label: Angle step
fields.validation: Positive finite; actual angle sample count <=361.
fields.error_message: Angle sweep must have at most 361 samples; increase the step.

fields.label: Meep wavelength minimum
fields.validation: Positive finite; strictly lower than maximum wavelength.
fields.error_message: Meep minimum wavelength must be below maximum.

fields.label: Meep wavelength maximum
fields.validation: Positive finite; strictly greater than minimum.
fields.error_message: Meep maximum wavelength must exceed minimum.

fields.label: Meep frequency samples
fields.validation: Integer 2..2001; frequencies are evenly spaced between 1000/λmax and 1000/λmin in µm⁻¹; wavelength spacing is nonuniform.

shared_state.device: One canonical finite device document with stable layer, region, contact and PC-array IDs. Shared by all modes and all views.
shared_state.optical: One authoritative optical settings object, shared by standalone Optical and the Coupled optical editor; mode changes do not copy or reset it.
shared_state.electrical: One authoritative electrical study object plus canonical device temperature, mesh, doping and contacts, shared by standalone Electrical and Coupled electrical editor.
shared_state.coupled: Only transfer, reference, mapping, material-response and tracking controls are Coupled-specific. Run adapter composes immutable job inputs from the two shared setups and the shared device.
shared_state.drafts: Visible numeric text is a draft until focus loss or Enter. Valid edits commit atomically and increment configuration revision. Invalid draft stays visible with a field error. Leaving a tab keeps the draft and its error; it is never silently clamped, rounded or reset.
shared_state.invalidation: Geometry, terminal, material, doping, temperature or mesh edits invalidate electrical preflight and transfer checks. Source, spectrum, material or domain edits invalidate optical preflight and transfer checks. Pure output selection invalidates run planning only. Completed results keep their saved immutable input revisions.
shared_state.preview_selection: XY pick selects the same object in XZ, 3D, tree and inspector. XZ cut y and 3D camera are UI state; they do not alter the physical device. Optical cell overlay is cyan, PC-area boundary is subdued dashed, finite-device edge is solid neutral.
shared_state.domain_separation: Changing optical cell width/depth/center never changes finite device footprint, PC-array area, contact dimensions or electrical mesh. Full footprint in S4 means a periodically repeated supercell, never an isolated finite optical device.
